name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: 🔲 Double screen board: + Double screen board in a hive's boxes. Plain (one entrance: back, front or closed) or Snelgrove (a pair of doors, upper and lower, on the left side, back and right side). The colony on top is its own hive, and each hive's page links to the other.

🗺️ Yard map: on each apiary's page, a drawing of the yard from above. Place your hives, their stands (a 4x4 each, or a shared stand), the gate, trees, fences and the like, and turn each hive to the way its entrance faces.

🎨 The map shows what needs doing (inspection due, feeder low, queenless, dead-out), your queens' mark colors, or your walking order (number them yourself, or let it suggest one from the gate). Tap a hive to open it or inspect it.
🔒 The map is kept on your phone only. It's never sent to your club.

🗣️ Buddy says "emerged" for a queen cell the queen has come out of (it used to say "opened", which sounded like "open"), and says how an entrance is now: "The entrance is open", "The gate is closed". "Chewed open at the bottom" is understood as emerged, not torn.

👥 My club: a 👥 Roles section (who does what), a member list you can bring in from Excel, personal invites, a printable meeting sign-in sheet, and asking to start your own club. Some of these turn on in the next few days.
🔎 Settings search: a section near the end (like 🧤 In the bee yard) now goes all the way up under the search bar.
